summary: Created src/telegram/create-repo-command.ts as a self-contained module exporting CREATE_REPO_COMMAND_SPEC and registerCreateRepoCommand(). The handler: (1) authenticates via resolveTelegramCommandAuth with requireAuth:true, (2) parses path + optional custom repo name from ctx.match, (3) resolves directory path using resolveUserPath with ~, absolute, and relative path support, (4) validates directory exists, (5) initializes git via ensureWorkingDir() if not a repo, (6) checks origin remote — returns existing GitHub URL if present, (7) derives sanitized repo name from basename (lowercase, hyphens for spaces/underscores, no special chars), (8) verifies gh CLI installed and authenticated, (9) runs gh repo create --private --source=. --remote=origin, (10) pushes current branch to origin, (11) replies with success/error messages. All subprocess calls use execFileSync. Handles errors: gh not installed, not authenticated, repo name taken, directory missing, non-GitHub origin. pnpm build and pnpm lint both pass with 0 errors.
